# JSON formatter

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/json-formatter/

Validate JSON and format it with two or four spaces, or minify it to a compact representation. Copy the clean result for development.

## How to use it

1. Enter a sample value, color, URL or structured input.
2. Choose the required format or options and run the tool.
3. Review the output and copy it into your own workflow.

## Example

Format an API response to make nested objects and array entries easier to inspect.

## Limits and checks

The input must be valid JSON, with quoted property names and no comments or trailing commas. Keep a copy of large numeric identifiers.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
